name: Additional Email Recipients
author: Arrow Design

sections.description:
Additional Email Recipients gives WooCommerce store owners a simple way to send copies of transactional emails to additional people.

Instead of editing WooCommerce templates or adding custom code, you can choose extra recipients for individual WooCommerce email types directly from WordPress admin.

What can I do with it?

  • Add one or more additional To recipients.
  • Add CC recipients to WooCommerce emails.
  • Add BCC recipients to WooCommerce emails.
  • Configure recipients separately for each available WooCommerce email type.
  • Enter multiple email addresses as a comma-separated list.
  • Keep WooCommerce’s normal customer and administrator email workflow in place while sending additional copies where required.

This can be useful when order notifications need to reach more than one member of staff, when a separate accounts or fulfilment address needs a copy, or when selected WooCommerce emails should be copied to another mailbox.

Simple WooCommerce email recipient management

After activation, open Additional Emails in the WordPress admin menu. The plugin displays the WooCommerce email types available on your site together with fields for additional To, CC and BCC recipients.

Add the email addresses you need, save the settings, and the additional recipients will be included when the relevant WooCommerce email is sent.

Need email logging and more advanced email tools?

If you also need to see a record of emails sent by WordPress/WooCommerce, Arrow Design offers Arrow Mail Log, a premium email logging plugin with additional email-management functionality.

Learn more about Arrow Mail Log:
https://arrowdesign.ie/product/arrow-mail-log/

Additional Email Recipients remains a standalone plugin; Arrow Mail Log is optional and is not required for this plugin to work.
sections.installation:
1. Install Additional Email Recipients through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open Additional Emails in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Add any additional To, CC or BCC email addresses required. Separate multiple addresses with commas.
  6. Click Save Additional Emails.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin works with WooCommerce transactional emails and requires WooCommerce to be active.

Can I add more than one additional recipient?

Yes. Enter multiple email addresses separated by commas.

Can I use CC and BCC?

Yes. Each WooCommerce email type has fields for additional To, CC and BCC recipients.

Does this replace the normal WooCommerce recipient?

No. The plugin is designed to add recipients to the existing WooCommerce email workflow.

Where are the settings?

After activation, open Additional Emails in the WordPress admin menu. A settings link is also available from the Plugins screen.

Is there a premium version?

For email logging and broader WordPress/WooCommerce email-management features, see Arrow Mail Log:
https://arrowdesign.ie/product/arrow-mail-log/
